svg.title: Estimated share of adults who feel lonely, by census tract, Monroe County, New York (CDC PLACES 2025 release)
svg.desc: Choropleth map of 207 census tracts. The darkest tracts, where 40% or more of adults are estimated to feel lonely, are almost all inside the City of Rochester; most suburban tracts are under 33%.
svg.text: Loneliness by neighborhood, Monroe County, NY
Estimated share of adults who feel lonely always, usually or sometimes, by census tract (2023)
Adults who feel lonely (number of tracts)
Data: CDC PLACES 2025 release (model-based estimates from BRFSS 2023); Census 2020 tract and town boundaries.
Thick line: City of Rochester. Map: Ruzicka Psychology, ruzickapsychology.com/research, CC BY 4.0.
